tasks.label: Build paper PDF (main.tex)
tasks.command: cd paper; pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex; bibtex main; pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex; pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex

tasks.label: Build paper PDF (template: thesis_main.tex)
tasks.command: cd paper; pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode thesis_main.tex; bibtex thesis_main; pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode thesis_main.tex; pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode thesis_main.tex
